sources.title: Settlement-axis table: axis bearings, horizons and layout dates of Harappan towns (town-axes package, 21 October 2026)
identifiers: plan citation with figure or plate and page
metadata_fields: line bearing and deviation from cardinal with one-sigma error and length
system deviation, standard error, spread and total length
north reference of each plan (true, magnetic, grid, unspecified) and survey year
IGRF declination for dated magnetic plans
apparent horizon altitude every 0.1 degree over azimuths 45-135 and 225-315
layout phase per part with excavator's range and basis
radiocarbon determinations with printed and 5568-year ages
layout start, evidence tier and date error

rights.detail: Bearings, coordinates, horizon altitudes and dates are our observations and compilations. Imagery, plans, DEM tiles and downloaded publications stay local-only; the measurement files record their URLs and hashes.
